resources.string: Off by default. Records network activity from activation until disabled, including background activity. Logs stay on this device in memory until the app process stops; export them before closing. No request bodies, headers, tokens or URL queries are saved.

HTTP body bytes count network transfers, including redirects and retries, without cache hits. WebSocket rows count application payloads queued or received, excluding automatic ping/pong. Android totals also include connection overhead and opaque libraries / WebViews; their individual functions cannot be identified. Retains the newest %1$d rows; %2$d older rows removed. Totals include removed rows; function summaries cover retained rows.
